_comment: Decomposition of the published margin. The headline compared a 5-vote fine-tune against a 1-shot frontier model on a prompt that named four classes without defining them. These conditions separate the definition effect from the decode-budget effect and report the matched margin.
aggregation_note: E as published used whole-dict voting, which PRE-REGISTRATION §4.4 forbids. E_prime is the same run re-aggregated with the corrected rule. The published margin is +0.0288 under the old rule and +0.0269 under the prereg's own rule; the apparent symmetry with the -0.0288 matched margin was an artefact of comparing two different estimators.
scope: EXPLORATORY, not confirmatory. PRE-REGISTRATION §4.5 requires held-out abbreviation pairs and §3 names the frozen test pool as the endpoint. This runs on seed-777 (v1), whose PARTIAL_MATCH overlap fraction is 1.0 -- a violation that FAVOURS the champion, so a compliant pool would push D-C further negative rather than back toward positive.

unmeasured.B_deepseek_rubric_x1: not collected: the provider account was exhausted mid-experiment (HTTP 402 Insufficient Balance). The combined definition+budget effect is reported; the split between them is unmeasured, not estimated.
